[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] '''Corlen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Japrael sector/Legends|Japrael sector]]. He was the political rival of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Lasre Dardano|Dardano]].
